summary: Regression test after Windows Electron packaging tweaks. ZIP download (118MB) served correctly with all 4 required entries present (ManuscriptBrowser.exe, Create-Desktop-Shortcut.cmd, README-اقرأني.txt, resources/app.asar.unpacked/icon.ico). Web app loads without regressions: splash brand mark (م gold icon), title مُتَصَفِّحُ المخْطُوطَاتِ, toolbar with all buttons, footer attribution all render correctly. No console errors. #ns=A child mode navigation works.
action_items: INFO ONLY (not a regression, not blocking): The data-testid attributes referenced in the review request (mr-splash-img, mr-brand-mark, mr-btn-about, mr-about-modal, mr-file-input, mr-scroll) are NOT present in the rendered DOM. Only these testids exist: sv-root, sv-bar, sv-panes-1, sv-panes-2, sv-body, sv-pane-A. Interactive elements like the toolbar buttons use class-based hooks (.mr-btn) with Arabic title attributes. If robust E2E testing is desired, main agent should add the promised data-testid attributes to the splash image, brand mark, about button/modal, file input, and scroll viewer.
seed_data_creation: Created /tmp/test_upload.zip with minimal JPEG for upload test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Windows packaging (icon.ico unpack, appUserModelId, Create-Desktop-Shortcut.cmd, README-اقرأني.txt) is fully wired into the ZIP artifact. Web app has no regressions. The data-testids described in review requests don't exist in DOM; only sv-* testids exist. For future UI E2E, either add the mr-* testids or use class-based selectors like .mr-btn plus title attributes (e.g., button[title='فتح مخطوطات'] uses a click-triggered native file picker via showOpenFilePicker/hidden input outside DOM tree). The actual 'Open' button is not a <button> element — it's rendered with class .mr-btn but as a div/span. Full ZIP was not extracted (only listed) per instructions.
